title: Medium Rare
description: Removes the thick black outlines on meat items
body:
# Medium Rare

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a9586f841f1a5c28603b0fb4d6feced7daa9594.png)
‎ 

Medium Rare is a texture pack that removes the black outlines on the meat items similarly to Minecraft versions 1.4 and up. Medium Rare supports minecraft beta 1.8 all the way up to release 1.3.
